title: context-pack-v6
description: NX-023 Context pack v6. Message Runs: the frozen v2 core (bindings, user_statement, formal_facts, current_constraints, supply), or the v4 core when the optional relationship_context section is present (current statements are resolved user statements only; hypotheses are evidence only), re-derived by SQL at bind; Role Runs: the frozen v3/v5 core under role and a service-trigger current_event, plus strategy, goal/control snapshot, labelled item sections, budget report and explicit insufficiency. Every item cites its source revision, canonical content hash and the current READ decision it was read under; SQL re-verifies each against the source row. Formal sections carry only governed objects/policy/ledger state; Claims under review appear only as source text; hypotheses never enter a real-world Context. No floating-point numbers. Server-assembled; grants nothing. v2-v5 stay frozen and old Runs keep using them.

operator_persona.description: 0227 operator persona slice 1 (docs/design/operator-persona-design.md): how the operator speaks to this Consumer, persona@version, re-derived and checked by SQL at bind; absent when the tenant has no usable persona.

preferences.description: 0228: the consumer's own communication preferences (from their Claims, not dismissed by the owner); data for the model; quiet hours, frequency, channel and topic are also enforced at dispatch.

outreach.description: Outreach slice 5 (docs/design/proactive-outreach.md §3.3): only in a plan reevaluation Run whose Role execution ceiling holds nexloop.outreach.send:1; the purposes this tenant has enabled in the current purpose list and the tenant's marketing state, re-derived and checked by SQL at bind. Whether to contact the customer at all is the Run's judgement (no_action is normal); every gate is rechecked at dispatch.
